# Keep reviewed session history after the application tab reloads

## What & Why
Popup reopen now preserves page history, but a browser reload is another common interruption. Confirm the locally stored session reconnects without duplicate listeners or losing reviewed page history.

## Done looks like
- Extend artifacts/escape-hatch/tests/assist.spec.ts using the unpacked browser/application-assist package.
- Fill and review at least two same-origin pages, reload the application tab, and reopen the popup.
- Assert the exported session still contains both page records and does not repeat fill actions automatically.
